# Dadu Food

> Dadu Food is Dadu city's own food, grocery and medicine delivery service.
> Order biryani, zinger burgers, pizza, shawarma, karahi and more from local
> Dadu restaurants, plus 297 grocery items and pharmacy products, all delivered
> to your home in 20-35 minutes.

- Website: https://www.dadufood.store/
- Phone / WhatsApp: 03277004471
- Email: support@dadufood.pk
- Address: Station Road, Dadu, Sindh 76200, Pakistan
- Food delivery hours: 12:00 PM - 11:00 PM, every day (Monday-Sunday)
- Grocery and medicine orders: from the morning
- Delivery fee: Rs 50 per order (food and grocery); Rs 30 for medicine-only orders
- Delivery time: 20-35 minutes
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD) and Easypaisa only (no JazzCash, no card)
- Delivery areas: Dadu city, Sindh, including Shahani Paro, Moro Road,
  Station Road, College Road, and nearby areas
- Grand opening: Tuesday, 15 December 2026

## Restaurants
